title: spiesia lanata
intro: Spiesia lanata, commonly known as the Himalayan Sweet Flower or Yashad Bhasma, is a plant species belonging to the family Rosaceae. The health benefits of Spiesia lanata include its potential to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Therapeutically, it is used to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory actions. The bioactive constituents of Spiesia lanata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
